source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
notes: Since the nominative possessor raises to Spec,IP and not to Spec,LocP, the latter can be projected independently of the possessor and a locative noun phrase (if chosen in the numeration) can merge in Spec,LocP. This explains the grammaticality of (45), in contrast to (42) above. In case no overt locative appears as in (43) or (44), location is interpreted as existentially quantified.
